keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Álvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, Real Sociedad 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Federico Valverde.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, Real Sociedad 1. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Real Madrid 1, Real Sociedad 1.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Marc Cucurella replaces Álvaro Carreras.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 1, Real Sociedad 1.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Igor Zubeldia replaces Jon Aramburu.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Orri Óskarsson replaces Mikel Oyarzabal.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Real Sociedad 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jude Bellingham with a through ball.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Ander Barrenetxea replaces Job Ochieng.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Carlos Soler replaces Yangel Herrera.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Real Sociedad 1. Vinícius Júnior (Real Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jude Bellingham.
Luken Beitia (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ibrahima Konaté (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Gonçalo Guedes replaces Takefusa Kubo.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Jude Bellingham.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz replaces Arda Güler.
Goal! Real Madrid 4, Real Sociedad 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Vinícius Júnior with a through ball.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Yan Diomande replaces Vinícius Júnior.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Carlos Espí replaces Bernardo Silva.
Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
